question: What decides the map's far view against the near, what changes with it, and how the map mode interacts.

addresses.name: MapGraphics_DrawScene
addresses.signature: void __stdcall MapGraphics_DrawScene(void* graphics, MapCamera* camera, void* view)
addresses.comment: **The map's 3D scene, each frame** - the in-game frame routine calls it at rva 0x25704B with (the graphics owner's +0x1DC4, CInGameIdler +0x1938 map_camera, idler +0x1788), the front end at 0x2EED3F, and once more at 0x29EBF2. 0x45BE50 to the `ret 0xc` at 0x45C6E8. Stores camera at graphics +0x20 and view at +0x24; takes the layer mask settings +0xF0 & +0xEC once. In order: **near = height (camera +0x348) < 100.0** (the double at VA 0x160A358, exe); MapGraphics_DrawTerrain (always); the level = 1 + the index of the last entry of CMap terrain_sheet_heights (default.map, 500 in TFH) the height is strictly above, 0 for none; MapGraphics_DrawBeaches (always); rivers (0x47C8A0) with mask 0x80 at any height; **the land borders (MapGraphics_DrawLandBorders) only while CMap border_cutoff (default.map 500.0) > height** and mask 0x2; MapGraphics_DrawWater with mask 0x100; the shore (MapShore_Draw) where graphics +0x42E9 is set; the water borders (0x45DD50) with mask 0x200; **the trees (0x463930) only under 100** and with mask 0x1; MapGraphics_DrawTerraIncognita only in a scenario (CCurrentGameState +0xD0C not null); **0x43ED10 - a per-country layer, by all appearance the country names - only where the level is above 0, the map style (settings +0xF4) is not 0 and no scenario is loaded**, given the camera's x_settled/y_settled; then the object groups whose visible byte MapObjects_UpdateLayerVisibility set; the layer under mask 0x8 (0x4608D0) under 100; and a call of 0x6BB7E0 (not read) only without always_counters and under counter_distance. No hysteresis: every test is the current height against a fixed figure. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-farmap.md, section A.
addresses.evidence: Decoded 0x85BE50 to its ret 0xc at 0x85C6E8 and listed every jcc: each gated call above sits under the compare named (0x85BF0E 100.0; 0x85C0B3 loop over CMap +0x40/+0x44; 0x85C181 [CMap global]+0x2050 against the height saved at 0x85C095; 0x85C2C5 +0xD0C; 0x85C2DD/0x85C2E9 level and style). Callers by findRefs --callers 0x0085BE50: 3. Wrong if any of those jcc targets does not skip the call it is said to gate, or if [ebp+0xC] is not the camera (it is stored at +0x20 and its +0x348 read as the height, and the caller passes idler+0x1938, the recorded map_camera).

addresses.name: MapGraphics_DrawTerrain
addresses.comment: **The land, with terrain_2_0.fx, and the far/near switch for it.** 0x45DFB0 to the bare `ret` at 0x45E9AE; the graphics owner in EDI, no stack arguments. level = 1 + the index of the last entry of CMap terrain_sheet_heights (+0x40/+0x44) the camera height is strictly above (0 for none). **Map style (settings +0xF4) 0 - only the Terrain and Weather modes write it - uses TerrainShader_Graphical (+0x208) at every height**; otherwise level 0 TerrainShader_General (+0x210), level above 0 TerrainShader_General_Low (+0x214). Binds tex2/tex3 the province colour pair (graphics +0x4168 +0xC/+0x10), tex4 colormap.dds (+0xB8) under Graphical and colormap_political.dds (+0xBC) otherwise, tex7 stripes.dds (+0xC0) when not Graphical, tex5 map_overlay_tile.dds (+0x2C0) under General_Low else one of three noise textures by the global at VA 0x1A8565C, and **tex6 the texture sheet of the level** (+0x288[level]: texturesheet.tga, then texturesheet2.tga ...). The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-farmap.md, section A.
addresses.evidence: Decoded from 0x85DFB0: the loop 0x85DFE2-0x85E00C, the style test 0x85E017 and the three SetTechnique calls (effect slot +0xE8) at 0x85E034, 0x85E04E, 0x85E060 with the handles +0x208/+0x210/+0x214, which the loader stores at 0x851356/0x85136F/0x851388 straight after GetTechniqueByName('TerrainShader_Graphical'/'_General'/'_General_Low'). Callers: one, the scene at 0x85C07A (mov edi, ebx first). Wrong if the handle at +0x210 is not the one looked up by 'TerrainShader_General' - the loader shows it is - or if 0x85E9AE is not this function's end (0x85E9B0 opens a fresh prologue after one int3 and is called separately at 0x85C1A2).

addresses.name: MapGraphics_DrawLandBorders
addresses.comment: **The land borders, with TerrainShader_Border** (+0x228). 0x45E9B0 to the bare `ret` at 0x45EF46; the graphics owner in EDI. Picks the border texture tex2 from +0x298[level], level = 1 + the index of the last entry of CMap border_heights (+0x30/+0x34; default.map {150, 500} in TFH) the camera height is strictly above - so three textures, borders.tga, borders2.tga, borders3.tga. **Called only while CMap border_cutoff (default.map, 500.0) is above the height** and the layer mask has 0x2 (MapGraphics_DrawScene at 0x45C181), so in the far band no land border is drawn at all. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-farmap.md, section A.
addresses.evidence: Decoded 0x85E9B0-0x85EF46: SetTechnique with [edi+0x228] at 0x85EA22 (stored by the loader at 0x8513A1 from 'TerrainShader_Border'), the loop over [CMap+0x30..+0x34] at 0x85ED39 and the bind of +0x298[level] to 'tex2' at 0x85ED94. The texture list is built at 0x852216 ('/terrain/borders.tga') then a loop over the same vector with 'borders' and a number (the number's +2 is read for the texture sheets, inferred here by the identical shape). Wrong if CMap +0x30 is not border_heights: CMap::LoadKey's case for token 0x6B4 (border_heights in ghidra/saveTokens.json) passes this+0x30 to the list reader 0x45F450.

addresses.name: MapGraphics_DrawBeaches
addresses.comment: **The beach strips, with terrain_2_0.fx's beach techniques** - the same switch as the land: map style 0 BeachShader_Graphical (+0x218) at every height, otherwise level 0 (camera height not above any terrain_sheet_heights entry) BeachShader_General (+0x220) and above BeachShader_General_Low (+0x224). 0x45EF50 to the bare `ret` at 0x45F6DE, the graphics owner in EDI; called unconditionally by MapGraphics_DrawScene at 0x45C0DB. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-farmap.md, section A.
addresses.evidence: Decoded 0x85EF50-0x85F06A: the level loop over CMap +0x40/+0x44, `cmp [settings+0xf4],0` at 0x85F020 and the three handle reads 0x85F035/0x85F051/0x85F059, stored by the loader from 'BeachShader_Graphical'/'_General'/'_General_Low' at 0x8513BA/0x8513D3/0x8513EC. retsBefore(0x85EF50, 0x85F6E0) gives the one ret at 0x85F6DE. Wrong if the level used is not the >0 test (it is `cmp [ebp-8],0`).

addresses.name: MapGraphics_DrawWater
addresses.comment: **The sea, with water.fx.** 0x45F6E0 to the `ret 4` at 0x4602D6; called by MapGraphics_DrawScene with the layer mask's 0x100. far = the camera height is strictly above **any** entry of CMap terrain_sheet_heights (default.map, 500). It looks the six technique handles up again every frame (+0x240..+0x254). coloured = map style 16, 18 or 19 (MapStyle_TestForWaterColourTechnique, 0x45FAE6). Then: **settings simpleWater (+0xE5) set - WaterSimple / WaterSimpleColor at every height**; else far - WaterFar / WaterFarColor; else WaterNear / WaterNearColor, with `Time` set for the waves. So WaterSimple is the setting, not a third height band. Binds ColorTex colormap_water.dds (+0xC4), OverlayTex map_overlay_tile.dds (+0x2C0), FOWTex and the normal map. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-farmap.md, section A, and reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapmode.md.
addresses.evidence: Decoded 0x85F6E0-0x85FCC5: the loop 0x85F730-0x85F75A sets [ebp-0x21]; 0x85FB0F tests [settings+0xE5] (simpleWater per CSettings::CSettings); the branches at 0x85FB22/0x85FB39 (+0x24C/+0x248), 0x85FB62/0x85FB6D (+0x244/+0x240), 0x85FBF6/0x85FBFE (+0x254/+0x250) all reach SetTechnique (effect slot +0xE8). Caller 0x85C1E0 under `test [ebp-0x14],0x100`. Wrong if +0xE5 is not simpleWater - GraphicsSettings' save order (settings window findings) puts simpleWater at +0xE5.

addresses.name: MapGraphics_DrawTerraIncognita
addresses.comment: **The terra incognita overlay, with terraincognita.fx**: TerraIncognitaFar (+0x2B0) where the camera height is strictly above any entry of CMap terrain_sheet_heights, TerraIncognitaNear (+0x2B4) otherwise. 0x4602E0 to the `ret 4` at 0x4608C2. Drawn by MapGraphics_DrawScene **only while a scenario is loaded** (CCurrentGameState +0xD0C not null), so never in the full game. In the install's terraincognita.fx the two techniques compile the same pixel shader (PixelShader_TIFar) with the same states, so the switch changes nothing on screen. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-farmap.md, section A.
addresses.evidence: Decoded 0x8602E0-0x8603BB: the loop sets [ebp+0xb] on the first threshold exceeded and 0x860397 picks [ebx+0x2b0] or [ebx+0x2b4] for SetTechnique; the loader stores those two at 0x851C49/0x851C62 from 'TerraIncognitaFar'/'TerraIncognitaNear'. The scene's call at 0x85C2CF sits under `cmp [state+0xd0c],0; je`. Wrong if a second caller draws it outside a scenario: findValue for the entry finds only the scene's call (not run as findRefs --callers; checked by reading the scene).

addresses.name: MapShore_Draw
addresses.signature: void __stdcall MapShore_Draw(MapCamera* camera@EAX, void* shore@stack:4, void* graphics@stack:8, void* view@stack:0xC, void* list@stack:0x10)
addresses.comment: **The surf along the coasts, with beach.fx.** The camera in EAX (its +0x348 read before the prologue ends), four stack arguments, `ret 0x10` at 0x433031. count = how many entries of CMap terrain_sheet_heights (through the map global, VA 0x1A8557C) the height is strictly above: 0 - technique BeachShader (the shore texture, added), otherwise BeachShaderColor (a black line at 70% alpha). Called by MapGraphics_DrawScene at 0x45C213 where graphics +0x42E9 is set, with (graphics +0x4164, graphics, view, graphics +0x78). Only the technique choice was read. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-farmap.md, section A.
addresses.evidence: Decoded 0x832C70-0x832D49: the counting loop over [[0x1A8557C]+0x40..+0x44] and the push of 'BeachShader' (0x15E0DF0) or 'BeachShaderColor' (0x15E0E64) to the effect's slot +0xE8. Inferred because the rest of the body (what it draws with them) was not read, and +0x42E9 is not identified. Wrong if the 0x15E0E64 branch is not reached on a non-zero count (0x832D1F `cmp [ebp-4],0; jne 0x832d39`).

addresses.name: MapGraphics_Update
addresses.signature: void __stdcall MapGraphics_Update(void* graphics, MapCamera* camera, void* unknown, bool force)
addresses.comment: **The map's pictures and layers brought up to date, each frame** - called by the graphics owner's update (rva 0x241D00, with graphics owner +0x1DC4 and its +0x60DC) and at 0x29EB69. `ret 0x10` at 0x45D950, with a cold block past it reached from 0x45C7F1 (trap 3); the `ret 4` at 0x45DB1C was not attributed. Read in part: under height 100 (VA 0x160A358) it rebuilds the tile strips (0x462260, 0x455EA0); keeps the height at +0x4174; **far = camera height strictly above counter_distance (settings +0xFC)** at 0x45D7B2, handed to ProvinceGraphics_Update for every province graphics entry from 1 - which is where each unit's avatar is told it is seen from far; then MapObjects_UpdateLayerVisibility. The third argument's slot is reused as a local. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-farmap.md, section A.
addresses.evidence: Decoded 0x85C6F0-0x85D950: 0x85D7B2-0x85D7D2 compares [camera+0x348] with [GetGameSettings()+0xFC] (`comisd height, cd; ja` sets [ebp+0x10]=1), and 0x85D830-0x85D84D pushes that byte as ProvinceGraphics_Update's fourth argument. Callers by findRefs --callers 0x0085C6F0: two. Inferred because most of the body (0x85C743-0x85D6B4) was not read. Wrong if the byte pushed at 0x85D830 is not [ebp+0x10] as last written at 0x85D7CC/0x85D7D2.

addresses.name: MapObjects_UpdateLayerVisibility
addresses.comment: Each frame (from MapGraphics_Update, rva 0x45C6F0, at 0x45D88D), sets the visible byte (+0x179) of the map object groups at +0x44..+0x70 of the graphics object, and of the 18 layers embedded in the object at its +0x4158 (0x17C apart from +0x188, the byte at +0x301 + 0x17C*k), from the layer mask (settings +0xF0 & +0xEC), the camera's height h (camera +0x348), counter_distance cd (settings +0xFC), always_counters (+0xF9) and two constants. **+0x5C (mask 0x20, the building pictures) and +0x70 (settings +0xE7) only while h < 500.0** (the double at VA 0x160A538) - the compare that takes the buildings off the far map; +0x44 only while h < 150.0 (the float at VA 0x15E3170); +0x48 mask 0x10; +0x4C mask 0x10 and h < cd; +0x60 any mask; **+0x64 only where the mask has 0x20 and CMap +0x2A90 is 11** - only in the weather map mode (its mask 0xFFBB has 0x20). In the +0x4158 object: under cd with mask 0x800 (counters) layer 2 = always_counters, layers 10 and 0 = not always_counters, layer 7 on, and layer 11 = mask 0x400; **from cd to under 500 layer 1 = mask 0x800 and layer 6 on**; layers 16 and 5 only under 500; layer 17 under cd with mask 0x400. So at 500 and above every unit layer is off - **no counters in the far view**. Which layer holds what is inferred from the bits (0x800 counters, 0x20 buildings, as ProvinceGraphics_HitTest reads them). What +0x64 holds was not read. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-farmap.md, section A, and reversing/findings/FINDINGS-weathersim.md, section C.5.
addresses.evidence: Decoded 0x85BBB0 to the two ret 4 at 0x85BE3A/0x85BE4D; xmm0 = [camera+0x348], xmm2 = [settings+0xFC], xmm1 = the double 500.0 at 0x160A538, and the float 150.0 at 0x15E3170 compared at 0x85BCD7. Revised: the old comment named the constants only as 'two constants' and did not read the +0x4158 layers. Wrong if xmm1 is reloaded between 0x85BC01 and its uses (it is not), or if the +0x4158 bytes are not visible bytes of embedded objects (inferred from the 0x17C spacing and the shared +0x179).

addresses.name: CUnit::UpdateAvatar
addresses.signature: void __thiscall CUnit::UpdateAvatar(CUnit* this, float unused, bool far, int stackIndex, bool refreshIntel)
addresses.comment: **Slot 36 of CUnit, CArmy and CAir: a unit's avatar (+0x164) told how it is seen this frame.** Called by ProvinceGraphics_Update for every unit of a province with MapGraphics_Update's far flag (camera height above counter_distance). Writes the avatar's seen_from_far (+0x152) = `far` **inline** - CHoiAvatar's slot 92 is not called - and its near counter's (+0x140) order (+0x1A8) = `stackIndex`; then for the played country's own units each counter's mark_yellow (+0x1BB), mark_red (+0x1BC) and mark_orange (+0x1BD) from the unit's fields; then CUnit_RefreshIntelLevel(this, refreshIntel). `ret 0x10`; the float (0.1 from the caller) is not read here. CNavy overrides it. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-farmap.md, section A.
addresses.evidence: vtable.py CArmy CNavy CAir CUnit --all: slot 36 = 0x5CD040 for CUnit, CArmy and CAir, 0x5CF290 for CNavy. Decoded 0x5CD040-0x5CD171: `mov dl,[ebp+0xc]; mov [eax+0x152],dl` with eax = [ecx+0x164], and the caller ProvinceGraphics_Update at 0x63F1F2-0x63F213 pushes (1, count-1, far, 0.1) through [vft+0x90]. Wrong if +0x164 is not the avatar (CHoiAvatar's own +0x13C/+0x140 counters are written through it, matching the record).

addresses.name: CNavy::UpdateAvatar
addresses.signature: void __thiscall CNavy::UpdateAvatar(CNavy* this, float unused, bool far, int stackIndex, bool refreshIntel)
addresses.comment: CNavy's slot 36, its own version of CUnit::UpdateAvatar: the same writes - the avatar's seen_from_far (+0x152) = `far` at 0x1CF492, the near counter's order (+0x1A8) = `stackIndex` - with a fleet's own marks. `ret 0x10` at 0x1CF639. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-farmap.md, section A.
addresses.evidence: Held at slot 36 by CNavy only (vtable.py). 0x5CF480-0x5CF492 reads [ebp+0x10] into the counter's +0x1A8 and [ebp+0xc] into the avatar's +0x152; retsBefore(0x5CF290, 0x5CF700) has the one ret 0x10 at 0x5CF639. Only that part of the body was read.

addresses.name: CHoiAvatar::SetSeenFromFar
addresses.comment: Slot 92: stores the byte at +0x152, which CHoiAvatar::HitTest reads as "the far counter is the one on screen". **What sets the byte each frame does not call this slot**: CUnit::UpdateAvatar and CNavy::UpdateAvatar (slot 36) write +0x152 inline, with the far flag MapGraphics_Update works out as camera height > counter_distance. No caller of slot 92 on an avatar was found (three of the eight +0x170 call sites slotcalls.py lists were read and none is one). The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-counters.md and reversing/findings/FINDINGS-farmap.md, section A.
addresses.evidence: Revised comment only: 'who calls it was not found' is replaced by where the byte is really written (0x5CD05A, 0x5CF492). slotcalls.py 92 lists 8 sites; 0x8B239C and 0x47951B are reads of a field at +0x170, 0x6D894F calls slot 92 of the object at +0xBE8 (another class); the other five were not read, so 'no caller' stays a negative with that limit. The method's positive control: the same scan finds 0x6D894F, a real two-instruction slot call.

struct_fields.name: tree
struct_fields.comment: default.map's `tree` (TFH 350; the constructor's default 400), an int read by ParseInt. The tree draw (0x463930) draws nothing above it and fades the trees from 0.3 x tree up; but the scene calls the tree draw only under the hardcoded height 100, so with TFH's 350 the trees are at full strength whenever drawn.
struct_fields.evidence: Revised from unknown_2a80: CMap::LoadKey's case for token 0x29D (tree) is the jump-table target 0x48963B, `lea eax,[ebx+0x2a80]; call ParseInt (0xA7B470)` - one int, which settles the doubt the old comment raised. Read by 0x863940 against [camera+0x348], with 0.3 (0x160A3E8) and 0.8 (0x160A3E0).

struct_fields.name: map_style
struct_fields.comment: style the water shader picks its technique from; 16, 18, 19 colour the sea. **0 makes the land and beaches TerrainShader_Graphical / BeachShader_Graphical at every height and suppresses the far per-country layer** (MapGraphics_DrawScene); only the Terrain (mode 0) and Weather (mode 11) setters write 0. Per mode: 1 Political 2, 2 Diplomatic 6, 3 8, 4 Supply 9, 5 Infrastructure 9, 6 Intel 12, 7 VP 13, 8 Theatre 14, 9 Strength 15, 10 Resources 20, 12 Revolt 2, 13 Simplified Terrain 8, 14 deployment 11, 15 (set at 0x2773C1, beside the orders view) 16, 17 2, 18 Air 18, 19 Naval 19.
